Commentary.Commentary: Terrific comeback from India! At 175-1 in the 33rd over, you would have surely felt that Australia are on course for another big total but that was not to be. After the centurion, Khawaja departed, the Australians lost their way completely. They lost 5 wickets for the next 50 runs and during that period the run rate also slowed down. At one stage 250 also seemed tough but a handy partnership from Cummins and Richardson meant they got to something which you can say is just about par on a slower surface. 273 is the target and India will have to bat well to chase this down. The question however is, will the wicket ease out, will the dew come into play or will the surface worsen? Join us to find out in a while.

OUT! Richardson is short as they referred for a run out appeal upstairs. A yorker on middle, this is flicked towards mid-wicket. The batsmen take one and then they go for the second which was never on. Dhawan in the deep fires it to the keeper who collects it and throws it at the stumps. He appeals, the umpire takes it upstairs and replays show that Jhye is short. Just a run from the last ball. AUSTRALIA FINISH WITH 272!
FOUR! Lucky one but a much-needed. Full and outside off, JR looks to hit it over the leg side but gets a leading edge over the short third man fielder and into the fence.
A bye taken! Seam-up delivery outside off, Lyon looks to cut but misses. Jhye wants strike so he goes for the run. Pant misses his shy.
Continues bowling the slower one. Jhye is way too early into the shot. He mistimes it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Another slower ball outside off, Richardson once again swings but only connects with thin air.
Full and outside off, Richardson looks to put bat on ball but misses.
Slower ball and outside off, Lyon looks to sweep but misses.
Richardson guides it towards point for a run.
Lyon is off the mark as he flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Nathan Lyon walks in.

OUT! It is not a bump ball and it is an unlucky dismissal for Cummins! Kumar bowls it very full and on middle, Cummins looks to swing but ends up getting an inside edge. It hits his pad and then lobs towards the bowler who takes it and appeals. The umpire is not sure whether it has bounced or not and he takes it upstairs. The soft signal is not out. Replays roll in and they show that Cummins has to take the long walk back. A handy cameo from him and a vital stand for Australia and a frustrating one for India come to an end.
Appeal for a catch! Is it a bump ball? The umpires go upstairs and the soft signal is not out.
Slower one, short and wide outside off, the batsman reaches out and hits it to sweeper cover for a couple of runs. This is a terrific partnership.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Length ball on off, Cummins runs it down to third man and takes a run.
This is eased through mid on for a run.

FOUR OVERTHROWS! So that is three consecutive boundaries now. Very needless from Bumrah this. He bowls it on a length and around middle, Richardson works it to the right of Bumrah. He collects it and then throws it at the stumps at the striker's end. The batsman is in but the ball deflects off the stumps, past the keeper and into the fine leg fence. Bonus runs for the Aussies.
FOUR! Fuller ball on off, Richardson frees his arms and drives it through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Educational edge that! Length and outside off, Richardson looks to run it down to third man but it goes off the outside edge, a lot finer than Jhye wanted it to and a boundary results.
Up and over! Richardson manages to get enough on that as he clears mid-wicket. The batsmen take two.
A single to end a good over for the Aussies. Richardson guides it towards point for a run. Australia will love a couple of more overs like this.
Down the leg side, Richardson looks to flick but misses. It has been wided.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Jhye has driven it through mid-off. One run added to the total.

Good fielding! Cummins swings again, this time it is not off the middle but since there is no one in the deep mid-wicket region it is safe. Shankar makes good ground to his left and stops the ball before it crosses the ropes. Saves a run for his side.
FOUR! Solid shot! Much-needed boundary! Slightly fuller and on off, Cummins makes room and then hits it over mid off and a boundary results.
Angled into the batsman, Cummins works it towards mid-wicket.
Slower ball on middle, Cummins strokes it down to long on for a run.
Pat Cummins is the new batsman.

OUT! Another one bites the dust and the last recognized batsman has been dismissed. 250 now looks farfetched! The slower ball outside off, Carey looks to drive but gets an outside edge which goes low towards the keeper. Pant takes a very good catch diving forward.
A straighter line and Carey works it to mid-wicket. Another dot.
On the fuller side and on middle, the batter strokes it down to long on for a run.
Slower ball and on off, Jhye works it towards mid-wicket.
Length and on off, it is kept out.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Back of a length on off, JR pushes it to covers.
Australia losing the plot. The wicket of Usman Khawaja has turned the tide completely in India's favour.
Good length on off, it is kept out.
Richardson is off the mark as he works it with the angle through mid-wicket and takes one.

OUT! CHOPPED IT ON! The slower ball does the trick, it is on a length and outside off. Not too far outside off though. Stoinis still looks to cut but gets an inside edge onto his stumps. Another big-hitter fails to make an impact and India are now into the bowlers.
Close shave! This one is angled away from the batter. Carey guides it towards point and the batsmen set off for a run. Jadeja there has a shy at the striker's end but misses.
Marcus shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
On the shorter side around middle, Stoinis stands tall and works it through square leg for a couple.
Alex flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Stoinis has punched the ball off the back foot. Spirited effort by the fielder to save runs for his team. They pick up a single.
The batsman has nudged the ball fine down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Back of a length on off, Stoinis stands tall and guides it through point for a run.
Works it with the angle towards mid-wicket.
Length again and on off, Carey opens the face of the bat and guides it to point.
On a length and around off, the batsman strokes it to mid off.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.
On the stumps, defended.
BEATEN! Length and on off, this pitches and straightens. Stoinis looks to defend but gets beaten.
The googly, Carey lunges and tries to defend but it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
Stoinis now strokes it down to long on for a run.
Tosses it up on middle, it is kept out.
SIX! Stoinis is not gonna wait. Kuldeep tosses the ball on off, Marcus comes down the track and sends it sailing over the long off fence for a maximum.

OUT! Turner holes out! Once again the shot can be questioned, with 7 from the first ball, was this shot necessary? Don't think so, especially with 8 overs left after this and Carey the only batsman left, this was certainly not on. Kuldeep bowls the googly and lands it on leg. Turner looks to tonk it over long on against the turn. He ends up mistiming it high up in the air towards long on. Jadeja there runs to his right, settles under it and takes it.
Pressure getting to Kuldeep here! This is wide outside off and it has been left along. Wide.
SIX! Poor bowling and it has been put away! Short and it sits up to be hit. Turner goes back and pulls it with ease, over the mid-wicket fielder and over the mid-wicket fence.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery on the stumps, Marcus taps it back to the bowler.
Beaten! Beauty of a delivery, on a length just around off and straightening a bit, Stoinis is caught pushing and missing inside the line.
Outside off, played down to point.
Turner has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. No run.
Once again short, Stoinis cuts it but straight to the fielder at point.
Shorter in length by Kuldeep, Turner pulls it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Turner is happy to play Kuldeep off the back foot. Does so here but pushes it to covers.
Uses his feet and then tries to defend but the ball goes off the pads towards mid off for a run.
The googly on off, Turner adjusts at the very end and guides it towards point for a run. 200 up for the Aussies.
Slightly quicker through the air and on the stumps, Turner pushes it to cover.
Kuldeep Yadav is back on.
FOUR! What a shot! Nothing prettier than hitting it straight back past the bowler. Stoinis finds the line and length to his liking and crunches it down the ground for a boundary.
Turns a length ball on middle to mid-wicket and crosses for a run.
Too full and on off, a hint of reverse swing there, Turner goes hard at it and it goes off the inner half to mid on.
Wicket to wicket line, Turner gets behind the line and blocks it back safely.
Lands it on a length and just outside off, Stoinis opens the face of the bat and pushes it to the right of point fielder. They cross for a brisk single.
Good length delivery just around off, Stoinis gets forward and across before defending it close to his front pad.
A dot to end as Turner flicks it to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Edgy four! The question here is, where is the slip fielder? The pressure is on Australia at the moment and you have to have a slip in. There isn't one and Australia benefit. Floats it up outside off, Turner goes hard at it but gets an outside edge through the vacant first slip region and into the fence. Releases all the pressure that was building.
This is angled into the batsman, Turner works it towards mid-wicket.
On the stumps, Turner blocks it out.
Flatter and on middle, Turner keeps it out.
This is hit through covers for a run.
Slower ball and Turner does not pick it. He is a touch early into the shot but ends up getting an inside edge onto his pads. 6 runs but the important wicket of Handscomb from the over.
On the stumps and it is kept out.
Now strokes it nicely through covers and the batsman take two.
FOUR! Continuing from where he left off in the last game. Full and on the pads, Turner flicks it through wide mid on and the ball races to the fence.
It's now the turn of Ashton Turner.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Another set batsman is back in the hut and the crowd here erupts. Shami gets his first and a much-needed wicket for him today. Excellent delivery. Bends his back on this one and lands it on off, this one pitches and takes off. Handscomb looks to guide it down to third man but gets an outside edge to Pant. The Indians are ecstatic at the moment and there are now two new batsman out in the middle.

Direct hit and that would have been close! Handscomb hits it straight to Kohli at covers. Stoinis does not realize it is straight into the hands of the fielder there as he is backing up a long way. The fielder has a shy but misses.
Mohammed Shami is back on.
A single down to long off to end. Another tight one by the left-arm spinner.
Tosses it up on off, PH finds cover with a drive.
A little bit wide outside off, MS strokes it through covers for a single.
Another one on the stumps and Stoinis keeps it out.
Fires it on middle, it is defended.
This is eased down to long off for a run.
On the off pole and it has been blocked. India now also applying the breaks on the scoring as just 5 has come from the last three.
Back of a length on off, kept out.

Fifty for Handscomb. Follows his ton with a half ton and is still not done. He is set and needs to stay there as it is not easy for a new comer on this wicket. His 4th in ODIs. Gets there by guiding it down to third man for a run.
Another slower one on middle, Peter strokes it uppishly towards mid on.
Almost chops it on! Signs of the wicket slowing down here. Short and outside off, Handscomb looks to cut but gets an inside edge towards the keeper.
Kohli is on fire in the field. Skipper leading from the front. A length ball on middle, Handscomb flicks it towards mid-wicket where Virat makes a diving stop. Peter remains on 49!

A huge appeal! Jadeja is literally pleading but the umpire shakes his head. Inside edge. The straighter one on middle, it keeps coming in with the angle. Stoinis goes back to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. Another successful over for Jadeja comes to an end. Kohli is seen sharing a smile with the bowler, that was a clear inside edge.
Marcus Stoinis is the new batsman.

OUT! In the air... taken! Kohli takes his second catch in the space of 6 balls and Maxwell walks back without troubling the scorers a lot. A soft, soft dismissal this and a poor shot. He has just arrived to the crease and instead of getting used to the wicket, he goes for an expansive drive through the off side. The ball though sticks in the surface and he ends up hitting it uppishly towards extra cover where Kohli takes it. Big wicket as the platform was set for Maxwell to get in and then launch. India right back in this now.
Well fielded, Shankar! Handscomb does well to guide it past the point fielder. They take one and think of a second. But Shankar gets to the ball in a flash and releases it quickly.
Maxwell is off the mark as he hits it down to long on for a run.
Fires it on middle, Maxwell keeps it out.
Handscomb strokes it through mid off and takes a run.

Drinks break. India have just managed to break the partnership and would like to pick a few more to stop Australia's charge. Glenn Maxwell has joined Peter Handscomb in the middle and if the former gets going, it will be huge trouble for the hosts. Virat Kohli has brought Ravindra Jadeja back in the attack to bowl a few quick economical overs.

OUT! Khawaja drills his drive through the line and Kohli takes a fantastic sharp catch at extra cover. The Indian skipper throws the ball in anger after that. Finally, the home team has managed to break the 99-run stand. A slower one by Kumar, an off cutter at 120.9 kph, Khawaja is probably deceived there as he mistimes his drive uppishly to Kohli. Usman cannot believe it. He has to walk back now.
Swing and a miss! Short in length outside off, angling away, Khawaja hangs back to play the pull shot but fails to connect.
Pitches it up and outside off, Khawaja drives it off his front foot to mid off.
On a length and around off, Khawaja pushes it back off the inner half of his blade.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Full and angling into the batsman, Handscomb drives it down the ground and the mid on fielder cuts it off.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back on.
A single to end as Handscomb sweeps it through square leg for a run.

100 for Usman Khawaja. He punches the air in delight. His second in ODIs and both have come in this series itself. He gets there by punching it through covers for a single. Takes the helmet off and soaks in the applause. What a series he is having! He has probably booked his place in the team for the upcoming World Cup. Can he make it a daddy hundred now and take Australia to a big score?
Eases this down to long on and gets to the other end. Gives the man on 99 the strike.

FOUR! Pant fails to react there! Peter makes room and steps down the track. Kuldeep tosses it up outside off. Handscomb looks to go inside out over covers but gets an outside edge, past the right-hand side of Pant and into the fence.

Well done, Jadhav! Good shot also! Handscomb uses his feet and then chips it over mid-wicket. Kedar runs to his left, collects the ball and then parries it to Dhawan who has run to his right from long on. Two taken.
Onto 99! Short and outside off, it is cut through point for a run.
A dot to end! This is on middle, PH mistimes it to mid on.
Nicely guided! The slower ball and Handscomb picks it. He just opens the face and guides it past the fielder at point. Dhawan at third man runs to his right and then saves two for his side.
Well bowled! The yorker at 141 kph. Handscomb gets his bat down in time and jams it out.
Length and around off, Khawaja hits it on the up to the man at covers.
The slower ball on the fuller side, Khawaja works it through square leg for a run. Moves onto 98.
Back of a length on off, Khawaja works it towards mid-wicket.
Yet another short ball outside off, Usman cuts it to deep point for one.
Fires one in flat and on off, Usman remains back and keeps it out at the last moment.
A long hop outside off, Usman cuts again but finds point.
Flatter and shorter on off, Khawaja cuts close to his body and nearly chops towards point.
Short and on off, Khawaja goes back and cuts it to deep point for a couple of runs.
Goes back to cut but fails to connect.
Spears in a fuller length ball on off at 141.3 kph, Handscomb drives but finds mid off. A tidy over by Bumrah, he has been economical all day (5-0-9-0) but has not provided any wicket.
Finds the gap this time. This one is a bit short on off, Khawaja opens the face of the bat at the last moment and dabs it down to third man for a run.
Back of a length delivery on off, Khawaja goes on the back foot and blocks it down with a straight bat.
Good length ball on off, Khawaja stays back and taps it down to point. Three dots.
Full and outside off, driven straight to covers.

Nearly produces a wicket first ball. Bumrah serves a length ball on off, angling in, Khawaja stays back to play at it, probably trying to guide it towards third man late but gets an inside edge onto the back leg.
Jasprit Bumrah is back on.
Loopy and too full outside off, Khawaja drives it through covers for one. Five singles from the over.
Full and wide outside off, Handscomb decides to sweep it and sends it behind square leg for another single in this over.
Allows the ball to spin back in and then works it through square leg for a single.
Goes down on one knee to a full ball and sweeps it through backward square leg for one.
Another short ball outside off, Usman this time delays his square cut and plays it away from the point fielder. But the short third man fielder cuts it off and they cross.
Short and outside off, turning away, Khawaja cuts but finds the point fielder. Misses out on a boundary ball.
Quicker one, Khawaja calmly tickles it in the gap at mid-wicket to keep strike. He moves to 90 now.
FOUR! Pulls and finds the gap! A rare short delivery by Jadeja, Usman swivels on the back foot and pulls it powerfully in front of square leg for a boundary.
This time Peter connects with his cover drive and sends it in the deep for a run.
Throws it up full and wide outside off, Peter tries driving it through the line but ends up mistiming it back to the bowler.
Fullish and on middle, knocked down to long on for a single.
Full and flat on the pads, it's flicked on the leg side but straight to square leg.

Goes against the spin but connects quite well. Full and on off, turning away, Usman goes down on one knee and sweeps it firmly to deep mid-wicket for one. 9 from the over, runs continue to flow for Australia.
Lands it full and just outside off, Usman presses forward in defense.
Play and a miss! Flighted and on off, Khawaja tries to sweep but it turns away to beat his bat.

SIX! High and handsome! Loopy and full outside off, not a lot of turn there, Usman wears his skates to reach the pitch of the ball and launches it over the bowler's head. Looking in ominous form, Khawaja.
A touch short around off, turning back in, Peter uses the depth of his crease and punches it down to long off for a run.

Kuldeep senses the charge from the batsman and bowls it wide outside off. It further turns away and Khawaja after coming down the track has to reach out. Does well to put bat on ball and forces it to sweeper cover for a run.
Kuldeep Yadav back into the attack.
Gets back and turns it in the gap at mid-wicket for one. 8 from the over, 15 in the last two, the current pair is settling in well.
Pushes it towards covers where Rohit misfields and allows a run.
Yet another reverse-batted shot. This time Khawaja fetches it from around leg and sends it racing away to sweeper cover. A single taken.
FOUR! Not from the middle of the willow but still a boundary. Tossed up again by Jadeja, full and outside off, Usman bottom edges his attempted reverse sweep past short third man.
Finds the fielder. Full and flighted on off, Khawaja reverse sweeps it straight to short third man.
Slower through the air around off, a shade short, Handscomb moves back and cuts it to sweeper cover for a run.
A touch short on off, Shami gets this one to cut back a bit into the southpaw. Usman somehow keeps it out towards mid-wicket.
Lands it on a length around off, Khawaja taps it down to backward point and a loud shout of no follows.
A touch short on off, Usman turns it off his hips through backward square leg. Good early call for two and Khawaja gets it easily in the end.

Beaten! Shami switches to 'round the wicket and beats the outside edge of Khawaja. He lands it on a length outside off, gets it to angle into the left-hander, Khawaja stays put to play it late but misses.

FOUR! Similar to the last boundary Khawaja hit in the previous Shami over. Just loves pulling across the line. Once again picks the length early, fetches it from outside off and muscles it over mid-wicket. 50-run stand comes up!
Good length ball around off, Peter gets across the stumps and works it to wide mid on for a brisk single. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end.
On the shorter side, Handscomb goes back and then opens the face of the bat, guides it through point and takes a single.
On the off pole, PH drives it back to the bowler.
This is angled into the batsman, Handscomb works it to square leg.
A little too full and this is eased down to long on for a run.
Brings out the reverse sweep but finds point.
Khawaja wrists it back towards the bowler who makes a good stop.

Shami bends his back on this one and bowls it short. Khawaja is hurried into the pull shot as he mistimes it towards square leg for a run. 8 from Shami's first of his new spell. He continues to be expensive.
He keeps playing a loose shot now and then but gets away with it. Once again he pokes at a ball which is way outside off and gets beaten.
The slower ball on off, Khawaja strokes it down to mid off.
FOUR! Crunched! Slightly short and Khawaja is onto the back foot in a flash. He fetches it from outside off and pulls it in front of square on the leg side for a boundary.
Another flick shot, this time it is closer to the fielder at deep square leg so only a run.
On the stumps, Handscomb works it with the angle through mid-wicket and takes two.
Mohammed Shami is back.
Fuller and on middle, Handscomb flicks it through mid-wicket for one. 6 from the over. 111/1, Australia.
Yet another reverse sweep from Khawaja, this time he middles it and sends it in front of square on the off side for a run.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
This one is flat and short on middle, Peter goes back and hits it firmly towards mid-wicket. Kuldeep dives there as the batsmen cross.
Loopy and full on middle, slower through the air, Handscomb presses forward and defends it back.

Good chase by Shami! Flighted ball around off, Khawaja brings out the reverse sweep but doesn't middle it properly. It comes off the bottom part of the bat and runs past Shami at short third man. He chases it down near the rope and they take three runs.
The last one was at 86.4 kph and this one is bowled at 68.9 kph. It is on off, Khawaja hits it to the right of the bowler. He fails to stop it cleanly and the batsmen take a run.
The quicker one and outside off, Handscomb guides it towards short third man and gets to the other end.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Plays it with a straight bat down to long off for a run.

OHHHH! The bottom part of the bat saves Handscomb there. Jadhav bowls this very full on middle, at 87.7 kph, Handscomb looks to sweep but then realizes the length is too full. He somehow gets bat to it and the ball rolls towards short fine leg.

FOUR! Very good shot! Uses his feet and then with the turn, lofts it over mid-wicket. It is in the gap and a boundary results. No risk in that shot as it was with the turn. 100 up for Australia, another decent partnership building here.
Kedar Jadhav to roll his arm over.
Jadeja continues to keep it tight as 3 comes from this over. The last ball is eased down to long off for a run.
The straighter one coming into the batsman. Handscomb goes back and looks to punch it through the off side but it goes off the inner half towards mid on.
Good stop! Flighted ball on off, Handscomb drives it back towards the bowler who saves a run by diving to his left.
Fires it on middle, Khawaja sweeps it through square leg and gets to the other end.
Sees Khawaja going for the paddle, fires it outside off. He still goes for it and gets an inside edge onto his pads. Needs to be careful with this shot against Jadeja.
Short and outside off, PH goes back and punches it through covers for a run.
Khawaja thinks of using his feet but Kuldeep bowls it quicker and flatter and outside off. UK opens the face and guides it to point.
Plays the sweep again towards deep backward square leg for a run.
Clever batting and good running! Plays the paddle sweep down towards fine leg. Runs the first one hard and then goes for the second. Completed.
Another tossed up ball and Peter flicks it to square leg with the turn.
Slightly shorter in length and outside off, Handscomb goes back and slaps it to covers.
Slower through the air on middle, Handscomb works it towards square leg.
A dot to end as Khawaja works it with the turn to mid-wicket. Just the 4 singles from this over.
This is angled into the batsman. Handscomb goes back and flicks it through square leg for a run.
Works it with the turn and gets to the other end.
Strokes it with the turn through mid off for a run.

50 for Usman Khawaja and his excellent form continues. His 8th in ODIs. He has looked fluent throughout and would be eyeing a big one here. He gets there with an excellent sweep shot through mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter and outside off, Khawaja opens the face and guides it to point.
Flighted on off, Peter hits it straight to the fielder at cover.

Lucky escape for Handscomb. He once again goes for the sweep but gets a feather on it and it goes quickly behind towards the keeper. Pant, there, cannot react quickly. The slip fielder dives but in vain and the ball races away to the third man fence for a boundary.

FOUR! Minimum risk and maximum reward. Handscomb loves the sweep shot and brings it out. Flighted delivery on the fourth stump line, Peter gets on one knee and places his sweep to perfection at square leg. Bhuvneshwar Kumar comes running from fine leg and looks to stop it with a dive but misfields and it goes away for a boundary.
Tossed up on off and middle, Usman comes down the track and nudges it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up leg spinner outside off, Khawaja leaves it alone.
Flighted outside off, the ball spins in to the right-hander. Handscomb waits and cuts it towards deep point and gets a single.
Flatter and on the pads, PH goes back and works it around the corner for a single. He is off the mark. A successful first over by Jadeja comes to an end.
On the stumps, it is kept out.
A little too full this time so the turn is out of contention. Handscomb strokes it towards mid-wicket.
Peter Handscomb replaces his skipper out in the middle and walks out at number 3. With two spinners operating, this is a good move from Australia.

OUT! TIMBER! An absolute beauty! Jadeja makes an impact straightaway. Announces his return into the team in style. Not a lot Finch could have done there. Jadeja bowls it flatter and around middle. Aaron does the right thing as he plays for the original trajectory by pressing forward. But the ball spins away, goes past the outside edge and uproots the off pole. The crowd here erupts and the dangerous opening stand has been cut short. Much-needed breakthrough for the Indians. They would now look to pull things back.
Flicks this with the turn through square leg for a run.
Khawaja straightaway plays the paddle, it is hit fine and the batsmen take two. Jadeja was appealing but not sure for what?
Spinners to operate from both ends now. Ravindra Jadeja has been introduced into the attack.
4 dots to end! A good comeback by the bowler. On the stumps and Finch strokes it back from where it came.
Finch dances down the track but Kuldeep shortens the length. Finch adjusts and works it towards mid-wicket.
The googly, Finch lunges and keeps it out.
Hit hard again towards the bowler. This time it is all along the ground. Kuldeep gets a hand to it but does not collect it cleanly. It deflects towards mid-wicket but not runs taken.

FOUR! Hammered! Right back over the bowler's head. Kuldeep tosses it up and seeing that Finch's eyes lit up. He steps out and smashes it over the bowler for a boundary. Kuldeep takes cover there and didn't even try for the catch.
Dances down the track and then hits it down to long off for a run.
Down the leg side, Khawaja looks to flick but misses. Pant fails to collect it cleanly but no byes conceded. Wide signalled.
Dot ball to end the over. Fuller on off, Finch hits it straight to the fielder at mid off. Bumrah continues to be economical but India want wickets from him.
Nice shot for a couple.. Length ball just outside off, Finch gets on his back foot and punches it wide of deep cover for a couple.
Confident block this. Length ball on off, Finch defends it with straight bat.
Finch looking at the ball carefully here. Defends this length ball right under his eyes.
Full length ball on off and middle, Aaron flicks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Good length ball on off, Finch shows respect to it and taps it back to the bowler.

Cleverly played! Kuldeep fires this one in outside off thinking that the batsman would use his feet again. Khawaja does not, he waits and then guides it past short third man for a couple. An expensive start by Kuldeep, 11 from his first.
SIX! All the way! First of the game and it is a long one. Khawaja once again uses his feet, this time gets to the pitch of the ball and deposits it into the long on stand.
On the shorter side, Finch goes back and works it through square leg for a run. You pitch it that short, it will be easy for the batsman to pick which way it is turning.
Now Khawaja steps down the track and then works it towards wide mid on for a single.
Uses his feet and then hits it down to long on for a run.
A little turn there! The googly to start with. It pitches outside leg. Finch does not pick it and looks to hit it across the line. He misses and the ball hits his pads.
Change in bowling. Kuldeep Yadav introduced into the attack.
On the shorter side, Khawaja gets on top of the bounce and then guides it towards point. Another good over by Bumrah, he has gone for only 6 in the 3 overs bowled.
A single after three dots! Very straight, Finch flicks it towards deep square leg for a run.
On the off stump, the batsman guides it to point.
Another ball played to mid-wicket. This one though was off the front foot.
Goes wide of the crease and bowls it on middle, Finch works it to the man at mid-wicket.
Back of a length on off, Khawaja opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a run.
Powerplay 2 time! Now a maximum of 4 fielders are allowed outside the ring.
A dot to end Powerplay 1! It has been all Australia, although India have tightened the grip in the last 4 overs. On a good length and around middle, Finch defends it onto the ground.
On the pads, Khawaja works it around the corner and takes a single.
On a length and around off, Khawaja pushes it to mid off.

Three runs! 50 up for the Aussies. This is also the third half century stand for this pair in this series. Ideal start for Australia. Finch with the angle works it through mid-wicket. It is the longer part of the ground so an easy three.
Stump-to-stump line and it is kept out.
Full but the line is a straighter one. Khawaja looks to flick but it goes off the inner half towards fine leg for a run.
On the shorter side and outside off, Finch punches it towards cover-point who fumbles but no runs conceded. Just a single from the over. 9 runs in the last three overs, India are pulling things back.
Length again and this one is angled into the batter. Finch looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Angles it into the off pole, Finch goes back and keeps it out.
Outside off, this one stays low. Khawaja slashes but it goes off the bottom part down towards third man for a run.
Length ball again and on off, Khawaja strokes it on the up to mid off.
Waits for the ball to come to him and then just guides it to point.
Shorter in length this time, Khawaja pulls it away for a single and keeps the strike.
Follows the boundary with a gentle push to the fielder at mid off.
FOUR! That's effortless from Khawaja. Kumar overpitches on this occasion. Usman is in great form and drives it straight as an arrow through mid off for a boundary.

Almost a disaster. Good length ball on off, Khawaja nudges it to mid on and initially looks for a single. Finch is not sure but still goes through with it. Khawaja then sees the ball has gone quickly to the fielder. So he decides against the run.
On middle and leg, Usman tucks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Length ball just outside off, Khawaja looks to cut it but gets an inside edge. It bounces on the crease and goes behind.
Change of ends for Bhuvneshwar Kumar.
Almost an action replay of the last ball. On off and it has been defended onto the ground.
On the off pole, Finch blocks it out.

NOT OUT! Easily in! Good fielding though. Khawaja takes a few steps ahead and then looks to hit it through the off side. He gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls towards the cover-point area. Finch calls for a run and the batsmen go for it. Kohli gets to the ball quickly and then scores a direct hit at the striker's end. An appeal follows and the umpire takes it upstairs. Replays roll in and it shows Finch is safe.
Shout for a run out! Direct hits are always close. The square leg umpire refers it upstairs. Finch is the batsman in question...
Good shot but well fielded! Slightly short and Khawaja picks the length early. He pulls it through backward square leg. Dhawan in the deep runs to his right, dives and saves a couple for his side.

This one stays low but another loose shot there by Khawaja. On a length and just outside off, Khawaja looks to guide it down to third man but gets beaten by the low bounce. That shot was not on as it was way too close to the off pole. Could have easily chopped it on.
Good delivery to begin but not sure if Khawaja needed to play at those. It was on a length and outside off, Khawaja hangs his bat out and gets beaten.
Jasprit Bumrah is on now.
A dot to end another expensive over by Shami. He has gone for 22 in the three bowled by him. On the off pole, Finch keeps it out.

FOUR! Now off the back foot! Pin-drop silence at the moment here in Delhi. This is even shorter than the last one, Finch has enough time to go back and then punch it through extra cover for the second boundary in the over. 8th of the game and we are only in the 6th over.
Shortens his length and also tightens his line. Bowls it on the stumps. Finch stands tall and blocks it out.

FOUR! In the gap, it is a small ground so it races away. Not a very bad delivery that, maybe Shami is guilty of offering some width outside off. It is on a length. Finch waits for it and then drives it square on the off side.
Not a good follow-up delivery but Finch fails to put it away. On the pads, Finch looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Unplayable! This pitches on off and then jags away at pace. Finch ends up playing inside the line and gets beaten. Not a lot you can do on those but just hope it beats the outside edge.
Does so with a dot! Just behind the driving length. Khawaja plays it nicely but to mid off. A good and a much-needed tight over from Kumar.
Now the single as Finch plays this with an angled bat, it goes down to third man. A good over so far, just two from it but he needs to end it well.
Looks to drop and run towards cover. Khawaja though sends him back. Three dots in a row.
Happy to play it late is Finch. On the off pole, Finch once again keeps it out right under his eyes.
Kumar goes wide of the crease and angles it into the batsman. Finch does not plant his front foot way too across and keeps it out with a straight bat.
Khawaja looks to drive it on the up but ends up playing inside the line. It goes off the outer half and down to third man for an easy run.

The delivery which comes in once again causing a problem there for Finch. He tries to defend but the ball takes the inside edge and hits him on his pads. 9 from this one and the last two overs have proven to be expensive, 19 in total.
Good length and around off, Finch strokes it on the up but finds the man at covers.
Make that 22 out of the 28 scored. On middle again, Khawaja works it towards mid on and gets to the other end.
FOUR! Delightful! Second boundary of the over. Khawaja at the moment is dealing in boundaries. Full and on middle, Khawaja lunges and then strokes it through mid on. He moves onto 21.
A loose shot this! Shami drags his length back and also bowls it just outside off. Khawaja throws his bat at a ball which was not there to be hit. Luckily for him, he gets beaten.

FOUR! And it gets better for the visitors. Another over starts with a boundary. Easy pickings for him. Full and on the pads, Khawaja clips it through mid-wicket and it races away to the fence. Khawaja now has 300 runs in this series. The man in form for Australia.

A single to end an expensive over by Kumar. 10 from it. Slightly short, Khawaja picks the length early and pulls it through backward square leg. There is a fielder in the deep so it is just a run. Australia are off to a good start here.

Khawaja is good straight down the ground as well. Kumar though is a good fielder on his own bowling. Goes fuller this time does Bhuvi. UK eases it back towards the bowler who does well to stop it with one hand in his followthrough.
FOUR! This time he connects with the flick and it races away to the square leg fence. Khawaja is way too strong on his pads, you do not bowl there to him. Second boundary in the over.

Howzzat? The answer to that question is not out. Going down with the angle. Kumar comes from around the wicket and angles it into the pads. Khawaja looks to flick but misses. It hits his pads. An appeal follows but the umpire shakes his head. The Indians have a chat but then do not review. They though would not have lost a review as Hawk Eye shows it would have clipped the leg pole.
Now follows the boundary up with a quick single! Good batting. On a length and around off, Finch pushes it towards covers for a quick run.
FOUR! A boundary to start Kumar's second. Width on offer outside off and Finch pounces onto it. He throws his bat at it and connects well. It goes through covers for a boundary.
A stylish flick, right off the middle but finds mid-wicket. That shot just shows how confident Khawaja is.

FOUR! Excellent! Yes, it is a half-volley but it still has to be put away! Outside off, Khawaja leans into the stroke and times it through covers. Once it is in the gap, there is no stopping the ball.
Similar delivery to the last one and Khawaja plays a similar shot to the same fielder.
Got it to leave the right-hander and brings it back into the lefty. Khawaja, however, plays it with the swing towards mid on.

Almost plays it on! On the shorter side and it is on the 5th stump line. Finch is guilty of going hard at it. It goes off the inside edge, past the leg stump and towards square leg for a run. Finch is underway.

What a beauty to begin with! This guy is in some rhythm. The ball starts around off which means Finch has to play at it. The ball though leaves him late, luckily for Finch it whizzes past the outside edge.
Mohammed Shami to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
A good length ball on middle and off, Usman goes on the back foot and turns it on the leg side. Finds the fielder. So, just a boundary off the first over.
Better line. Nice and full around off, Khawaja sticks back and defends it to the off side.
FOUR! Australia are away! Once again Bhuvneshwar Kumar is on the pads of the batsman and Khawaja beautifully flicks it past the square leg fielder for a boundary. No protection in the deep.
The line this time from Kumar is on the leg stump and the length is quite full. Usman plays it off his pads and pushes it to mid on.
This one is bowled on a driving length outside off. Angling away from the southpaw, Khawaja takes his front leg forward and then decides to make a leave.
Starts with a length ball landing on middle and off, Khawaja stays on the back foot and defends it to the off side.

The president of the DDCA rings the bell to mark the beginning of this match. The Indian team gets into a quick huddle. Aaron Finch and Usman Khawaja are the Aussie openers. It's going to be Bhuvneshwar Kumar to bowl with the first new ball. All set, here we go...

Indian skipper, Virat Kohli says they too wanted to bat first as it looks like a slow track. He hopes it does not break down a lot and the dew sets in later on. Mentions they are one of the best chasing teams in the world and they need to show that today. Further adds that the Aussies played better cricket in the last two ODIs. He feels that their team balance is just fine. Informs Chahal misses out for Jadeja and Shami comes in for KL Rahul to give an extra bowling option.

Australian skipper, Aaron Finch says that he wants to put runs on the board. Reckons much cannot be taken into consideration from the past scores as they are from long time back and very few international games have been played at this venue. On team changes, Finch informs that Shaun Marsh and Jason Behrendorff are out for the decider and Nathan Lyon and Marcus Stoinis replace them.
Toss - Aaron Finch calls it correctly at the toss and AUSTRALIA WILL BAT!

Shikhar Dhawan is caught down with a chat with Sanjay Manjrekar. Dhawan says that his performance was not up to the mark but he was just taking it into his stride and was analyzing his game. States that he was calm and continued his process. Mentions that he was just playing to the merit of the ball and he did not want to rush into things. Explains that he kept his composure and calmness and that helped him play his natural game.

Pitch report - Sunil Gavaskar and Murali Kartik are down for the pitch report. The former feels that this surface is going to be low and slow. States that there will be very little movement off the pitch but the ball won't come onto the bat nicely as it does on other surfaces in India. He expects dew to play a factor today. Gavaskar reckons there will be very little spin but feels it won't worry the batsmen. The Little Master expects a score of 250 should be par. Suggests that the team winning the toss should bat first but also adds that if dew comes into play later in the evening then that might play a part as well.

The series decider is here. Feroz Shah Kotla is all set to host the fifth and last ODI between India and Australia. The touring team has the momentum currently after back-to-back wins and for a change, India are on the back foot at home. They were expected to win this series, and that too quite comfortably, but the visitors have surprised them with their resurgence and now the Men in Blue will have to put their best foot forward to win the series. All to play for then and we are minutes away from Toss. Stay with us for all updates...
